create_fcos_model: create an FCOS dense detector model with backbone, head, and inference parameters
build_fcos_head: build an FCOS detection head with input shapes and convolution dimensions for centerness prediction
run_fcos_training: run FCOS forward training with images, features, predictions, and ground-truth instances to compute losses
run_fcos_inference: run FCOS forward inference on images and features to produce per-image detection instances
test_fcos_anchor_matching: test FCOS anchor matching by matching ground-truth boxes to multi-level anchors with quality matrix
